## Evaluate pathways downstream of IL1 (NF-kB)

### Evaluate cell cycle and NF-kB - PDX Tibia
```{r}
# Load the dataset
pdx_tibia <- qs::qread("output/seurat_objects/pdx_tibia.qs")

# Determine cell cycle phase for each cell and plot
pdx_tibia <- kill_cc(pdx_tibia)

p5 <- r_dim_plot(pdx_tibia,
    reduction = "fdl",
    group.by = "Phase",
    label = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "OS-17 Primary Tibia - Cell Cycle") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p5

# Pull the transcription-factor regulated gene sets from msigdb
sigs <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
    category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

gs <- "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"

# Quantify the NF-kB pathway activity and plot
cell_ranks <- AUCell::AUCell_run(
  pdx_tibia[["RNA"]]$counts,
  sigs %>% filter(gs_name == gs) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
)
pdx_tibia$nfkb_activity <- AUCell::getAUC(cell_ranks)[1,]

# Set scale common to IL1R1 plots
nfkb_scale <- scale_color_gradient(
  limits = c(0.1, 0.35), 
  # colors = c("#EEEEEE", "#AE0600"),
  low = "#EEEEEE",
  high = "#AE0600",
  oob = scales::squish
  )

p1 <- FeaturePlot(pdx_tibia,
  "nfkb_activity",
  reduction = "fdl",
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed() +
  nfkb_scale
p1
```

### Assemble the figure panel
```{r}

p
```
